1.why: src/TL_VULR.cpp:75 reads this jack, :78 takes its absolute value, :82 peak-follows it with a 300ms exponential release, and :85-93 divides that by the kFullScaleV 5V of :54 to light the fourteen right-hand segments

comment: Both inputs are read with getVoltage(), so only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is metered. The meter is a peak follower on the absolute value, so it reads the same for a negative swing as a positive one. The 14 lamps per channel are lights rather than controls and appear in no census list, so no click can reach them.
